notes.title: Thank you for playing — a new TOLOM demo is on the way!
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone, Inkrow Games here![/b][/p][p]We just wanted to take a moment to say a big thank you to everyone who played the TOLOM demo. The support has been amazing — way beyond what we expected — and we’re really, really grateful for it.[/p][p]Also, thanks so much for all the feedback you’ve been sending our way. We’ve been reading everything carefully, and it’s already helping us rethink and improve a lot of things. We know the demo still has rough edges and that there’s a lot to balance and polish, but we’re on it.[/p][p]In the next few days, we’ll be working on a new version of the demo — more content, better balance, and fixes for many of the issues you’ve pointed out. Once it’s ready, we’ll post an update so you can check it out.[/p][p]We’re also reworking some bigger parts of the game, like how exploration works. We think these changes will make TOLOM a lot more fun and exciting to play, and we’ll share more about that very soon.[/p][p]Thanks again for all the support. Can’t wait to show you what we’re working on! [/p][p]—[b]Inkrow Games[/b]  [/p]
